$comment: Household debt as a share of disposable income, Alberta and Canada. Statistics Canada reports this annually (fourth quarter) to 2019 and quarterly from 2020; we take the fourth quarter of every year so the spacing stays even and no frequency change is baked into the line. statcanPeriod pins that to the October reference period, so a run in the middle of a year cannot mistake the latest quarter for the year.
source: Statistics Canada table 36-10-0665-01, Distributions of household economic accounts, wealth indicators, Canada, regions and provinces, quarterly
